newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: CZECH PX50 CLOSES DOWN.
newsitem.headline: CZECH PX50 CLOSES DOWN.

text.p: 1400 GMT - The Czech PX50 closes down on Tuesday.
Czech shares lost ground on Tuesday with the equity markets mirroring the foreign exchange markets in focusing attention on Wednesday's planned economic stimulus package from the government.
Activity was low and analysts said the situation was unlikely to change until markets have had time to digest whatever plans the government unveils.
"(Before the announcement) I don't think you're going to see much activity. You might see some low volume trading here locally," said Jeff Ocenasek of Atlantik Financni Trhy based in Brno.
Although the government has been tight-lipped about its plans, large public spending cuts are widely expected and dealers are watching closely for any movement on interest rates.
Last week the government said it would coordinate policy with the central bank in the immediate future.
Among the blue chips, SPT Telecom , the most heavily capitalised Czech share, fell 55 crowns to 3,380 and Komercni Banka dropped 42 crowns to 2,205.
